name: Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai Keredo
original_name: 僕は友達が少ないけれど
source:
Love between two Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai characters (Kodaka & Sena).
Just twice isn't enough to sate their passion.

[edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE090167.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
《我的朋友很少》中羽濑川小鹰与柏崎星奈之间的恋爱故事。
仅仅两次，仍不足以平息二人的欲火。

[据[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE090167.html]DLsite[/url]编辑]
